body: The state of the economy is generally strong, although growth has slowed, and inflation remains higher than the Fed's 2% target.
The economy today is extraordinarily strong by nearly every historical benchmark, including relative to the years immediately preceding the pandemic.
GDP grew at 1.6% per year in Q1. Inflation is at 3.0%. The unemployment rate is 4.3%. The S&P 500 is up 25.8% since he took office.
